_doc: 寻宝（Play 读取）：每个世界几个候选埋宝点，按本局世界种子挑一个（同一个种子总是同一个地方）。hint 是旅行日志「活动」页里给的线索（中英）。pos 为 [x, z]，地面高度由世界的 height_at 给出。

dusk_lake.hint: 湖心小岛上，朝着木屋的那一边。
dusk_lake.hint_en: On the islet in the lake, on the side that faces the cabin.

dusk_lake.hint: 图腾山洞的洞口外，再往外走几步。
dusk_lake.hint_en: Just outside the mouth of the totem cave, a few steps further out.

dusk_lake.hint: 湖东南的林子里，夜里会长出仙境的那片空地西边。
dusk_lake.hint_en: In the woods south-east of the lake, on the west side of the clearing where the fairy glade appears at night.

dusk_lake.hint: 雪山顶上，石堆和旗杆旁边。
dusk_lake.hint_en: On the snowy summit, beside the cairn and the flagpole.

dusk_lake.hint: 南部林间草甸，石头小屋西边的草地上。
dusk_lake.hint_en: In the southern meadow, on the grass west of the stone cottage.

world_02.hint: 主岛西南，离光门不远的草坡上。
world_02.hint_en: On the grassy slope south-west on the main island, not far from the gate.
Behind the windmill on the west isle.
North of the stone ring on the north isle.

world_02.hint: 东岛观鲸台后面的小坡上。
world_02.hint_en: On the little rise behind the whale watch on the east isle.

world_03.hint: 月牙绿洲的西南岸，离水二十来步。
world_03.hint_en: On the south-west shore of the Crescent Oasis, about twenty steps from the water.

world_03.hint: 驼队营地东南的沙地里。
world_03.hint_en: In the sand south-east of the caravan camp.
At the south-west foot of the wind arch.
Outside the south-west corner of the step temple.

world_04.hint: 第二圈陆环的西北边，雕像和水环之间。
world_04.hint_en: On the north-west of the second land ring, between the statues and the water.

world_04.hint: 第二圈陆环的东边，捧镜雕像南面。
world_04.hint_en: On the east of the second land ring, south of a mirror statue.

world_04.hint: 第一圈陆环的南边，水渠底下。
world_04.hint_en: On the south of the first land ring, below the aqueduct.

world_04.hint: 穹顶外东南的海底，沉船再往东一点。
world_04.hint_en: On the seabed outside the dome to the south-east, a little east of the sunken ship.
